heroHeadline: Saudi Arabia Launches First Large-Scale Retaliatory Airstrikes on Yemen; Houthis Warn of 'Painful' US Reprisal
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia conducted its first major retaliatory air campaign against multiple Yemeni locations following Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport. Houthi leadership warned of a 'painful' retaliation if the US intervenes militarily, while the US Embassy in Riyadh restricted all personnel from Saudi airports citing an elevated threat assessment.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, The Hindu, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
